scope: Train delay-aligned peak-demand HGB models and select stable bounded capacity policies on validation only, separately for Coding and LMM
sources: Hash-verified v1 aggregated Azure token counts; no trace merging
target: max(input-token totals at origin t through t+delay inclusive)
features: Same 11 historical token features as Coding; correct actual UTC clock/weekend for LMM; no image features in newly trained models
train_origins: 12..863-delay; complete targets entirely inside first 3 days
validation_origins: 864..1151-delay for forecast ranking; 864..1151 for policy replay
warmup_policy: default hold during validation warmup; selected hold becomes active only at assessment boundary
feedback: positive q90 normalized residual from previous up to 288 fully matured validation-or-later origins; minimum96; same for learned and simple peak methods
hold_selection: validation reversals then billed slot-minutes; billed<=1.01*default and no worse shortfall/backlog/final backlog; default always eligible; select per method/capacity/delay
gate_vs_strong_baseline: strictly lower billed proxy; no worse shortfall, backlog area, final backlog or direction reversals
stability_gate_vs_same_forecast_default: strictly fewer reversals with <=1% billed overhead and no worse shortfall/backlog/final backlog
assumptions: same fluid queue assumptions as v1
